pages.text: Requires Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks 3.16, Iron's Lib, GeckoLib, Curios and Player Animator. Tested against Sable, Create Aeronautics ships, Zoltraak Cinematic and Frieren Void.
pages.title: Compatibility

pages.text: This book is the $(l)Frieren: Magic Compendium$(). You get one the first time you join a world; craft another from a book and an amethyst shard. It works on its own; with Patchouli installed it opens this richer version.
